lexical_exclusions.reason: natural-language description in README; canonical type remains Policy unless a typed PolicyDefinition contract is proven
natural-language plural description; canonical type remains Capability unless separate type is proven
generic descriptive phrase for M3 attribute schema, not a standalone Artifact Definition
collective phrase for objects authored using M3 grammar, not one Definition type

admission_rules: definition_kind MUST resolve to the Definition Family Registry when the object is a Definition-family standalone object
standalone kinds MUST resolve Artifact/Profile/Schema/Applicability contracts before admission
embedded section kinds MUST NOT be promoted to standalone artifacts without an explicit profile
M3 internal schema subtypes MUST NOT be promoted merely because their name contains Definition
descriptor-shaped objects MUST NOT bind to full metamodel-definition schemas
Definition-suffix M2 class presence does not prove semantic adequacy
lexical occurrence of the word definition MUST NOT mint a canonical type
